lost: the surface copper_ore within 20 tiles of your drop-offs is down to 1555 (48% of what was there). Plan the next step now: once it's gone, there are only two ways on. 1) Go underground: train a geological_surveyor (factory) and 'prospect' (or 'survey' a spot) to flag deep deposits as mining_zones, then 'drill' a drill_rig onto one: a deep_mine pumps 4 ore/s with no trucks. 2) Explore the map: ore_fields lists only fields in ground you've explored, so scout the rest (scout_buggy, recon_drone) to find more surface ore, then deploy an outpost_truck (or build a mining_refinery) beside a field you find and send trucks there with harvest x,y. Trucks won't go looking on their own: they only mine within 35 tiles of a drop-off
